campaign-9-carbon_city.desc: Upgrade this old aquarium into a state of the art attraction!
carbon_city_intro.title: Welcome to Carbon City
carbon_city_intro.text.0:
Carbon City Aquarium used to be top-of-the-line but as technology has moved on it has failed to keep up.

It has a good selection of tanks and livestock but the tanks are understocked, held back by a lack of new filtration equipment.

Your mission is to invest in new equipment and livestock and fulfil the potential of this old aquarium! Best of luck!
opt_carbon_gift_shop.title: Gift shop opportunity
opt_carbon_gift_shop.text.0: If we can get our gift shop sales high enough we may be able to negotiate a licensing deal with the major film franchise "Finding Bertie".
opt_carbon_gift_shop.text.2: We would have to prove we can sell a certain amount of Balloons, Copperband Toys and Shark Hats to secure the deal. Are you interested?
opt_carbon_gift_shop.reply.0: I'm a lean, mean, selling machine!
opt_carbon_gift_shop_complete.title: License Deal Acquired
opt_carbon_gift_shop_complete.text.0:
The contracts are signed. All of our gift shop items are now official "Finding Bertie" merchandise.

As a result the aquarium has gained a moderate boost to Base Prestige <sprite name="prestige">.
carbon_city_win_message.title: You win!
carbon_city_win_message.text.0: Nicely done. You made smart choices on where to invest your time and money and have built Carbon City Aquarium into a state of the art attraction, with some of the most prestigious livestock around! You are now ready for the final challenge. It's time to build a true Megaquarium. We're going to Megalopolis!
carbon_city_win_message.text.2:
You can continue to build here at Carbon City for as long as you want, this message will stay in your message log (accessible via the button in the bottom-left) until you're ready.

When you're ready to move to Megalopolis, let me know.
carbon_city_win_message.reply.0: I'm ready for the ultimate challenge.
